name: doc-review
description: Root manifest for pi (pi install git:github.com/danmactough/doc-review). Points pi at the extension that lives under ./plugin/. Claude Code and Codex CLI ignore this file and read ./plugin/package.json instead.

scripts.version: node scripts/version-manifests.mjs $npm_new_version && npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund && git add .agents/plugins/marketplace.json .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugin/.codex-plugin/plugin.json plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json plugin/package.json package-lock.json
